<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Johnston Press]], which owns ''[[i (newspaper)|i]]'', ''[[The Scotsman]]'', the ''[[Yorkshire Post]]'' and other [[United Kingdom|UK]] newspapers, enters administration after failing to secure a buyer. It is set to be de-listed on the [[London Stock Exchange]] on 19 November 2018. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/nov/16/owner-of-the-scotsman-and-i-newspapers-enters-administration (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**The death toll in the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] rises to 71, with the statewide total at 74. The number of missing and unaccounted-for people rises to more than 1000. [https://www-m.cnn.com/2018/11/16/us/california-fires/index.html (CNN)]
*At least 42 people have died while more than 20 others are injured in a deadly fire aboard a bus in [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46242382 (BBC)]
*A total of eight people die when a strong winter storm strikes the eastern [[United States]], causing tens of thousands of people to lose power. [https://edition-m.cnn.com/2018/11/16/us/snow-storm-northeast-southeast-wxc/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.it%2F (CNN)]
*Iran's [[Social Security Organization]] chairman Mohammad Taghi Nourbakhsh and his deputy die after a car accident during a visit to [[Gorgan]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/news/139648/Iran-Social-Security-Organization-head-his-deputy-die-in-car (Mehr News)]
*[[Disappearance of ARA San Juan|Disappearance of ARA ''San Juan'']]
**The [[Argentine Navy]] announces that [[ARA San Juan (S-42)|ARA ''San Juan'' (S-42)]], an [[Argentinia|Argentine]] submarine that disappeared on November 15, 2017, with 44 crew onboard, has been found on the seabed in the South [[Atlantic Ocean]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-46245686 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Timeline of investigations into Trump and Russia (July–December 2018)]]
**An unrelated court filing accidentally reveals that [[Julian Assange]], a major target of the investigation into [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections|Russia's interference in the 2016 United States election]], has been charged. [https://www.theguardian.com/media/2018/nov/16/julian-assange-charged-in-secret-mistake-on-us-court-filing-suggests (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/11/16/us/politics/julian-assange-indictment-wikileaks.html (''The New York Times'')]
*''[[CNN v. Trump]]''
**[[United States federal judge|U.S. federal district judge]] [[Timothy J. Kelly]] orders the Secret Service to temporarily restore [[Jim Acosta]]'s White House press pass. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/judge-rules-white-house-restore-cnn-reporter-jim/story?id=59243203 (ABC News)]
*Immigration officials from [[Myanmar]] intercept a boat of [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] [[refugee]]s {{convert|30|km|mi|1|abbr=on}} off the coast of [[Yangon]], and arrest all 106 passengers. The boat was en route to [[Malaysia]], after setting off from [[Sittwe]], [[Rakhine State]], with human smugglers and Rohingyas fleeing [[Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar|persecution]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-11-17/rohingya-refugees-detained-by-myanmar-during-malaysia-voyage/10506920 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] appoints [[Steve Barclay (politician)|Stephen Barclay]] as [[Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union]], and [[Amber Rudd]] as [[Secretary of State for Work and Pensions]] following yesterday's resignations of [[Dominic Raab]] and [[Esther McVey]]. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics/amber-rudd-returning-to-cabinet-as-work-and-pensions-secretary-a3992491.html (''Evening Standard'')]
*[[2018 Georgia gubernatorial election]]
**[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] gubernatorial candidate [[Stacey Abrams]] ends her campaign, acknowledging that [[Brian Kemp]] will be the next [[List of Governors of Georgia|Governor of Georgia]]. In a speech at her election headquarters in [[Atlanta]], Abrams emphasized that her statement was not a concession, and announced her intention to file a federal lawsuit against the [[Georgia (U.S. state)|state of Georgia]] for alleged mismanagement during the election. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/16/politics/stacey-abrams-concession/index.html (CNN)]
;Science and technology
*The first genetic analysis of [[hemimastigote]]s reveals they are distinct enough from other forms of life to be classified in a separate supra-kingdom. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/hemimastigotes-supra-kingdom-1.4715823 (CBC)]
*[[Redefinition of SI base units]]
**A new definition of [[International System of Units|SI]] units, e.g., the kilogram, the ampere, etc., is decided by the [[General Conference on Weights and Measures]]. They are now entirely defined by physical constants, and no longer dependent on any physical object, as was previously the case for the [[Kilogram#International_Prototype_of_the_Kilogram|kilogram]]. [http://www.npl.co.uk/news/international-system-of-units-overhauled-in-historic-vote (National Physical Laboratory)]
